DonorPerfect's **total cost of ownership (TCO)** includes monthly software subscriptions starting at **$89 for Essentials, $159 for Growth, and $299 for Enterprise** (with custom pricing for larger needs), plus one-time implementation fees of **$500–$5,000**, customization costs of **$1,000–$10,000**, training at **$500–$2,000**, and setup/data migration fees of **$500–$2,000**[1].

Official pricing requires contacting a representative for a personalized quote, as no public plans are listed on their site or third-party reviewers like TrustRadius[5][6]. All plans bundle core features like customizable donor management, integrated payment processing, reporting, email marketing (Constant Contact/Mailchimp), donation forms, and mobile app access[6]. No hardware or server costs are required[1].

TCO varies by organization size, complexity, and add-ons; for example, DonorPerfect positions itself as cost-effective, with fundraising fees from alternatives potentially covering a full year's subscription[1][4]. A third-party analysis rates its pricing affordability at 85/100 compared to competitors[1].
